subject: [RFC PATCH 7/7] selftests: cgroup: check that high_work reclaim is charged to the memcg

2026-09-24.patch_summary: This patch adds two selftests to the Linux kernel's cgroup testing framework. The first test, `test_memcg_high_work`, checks that high-work reclaim is charged to the memory control group (memcg) by filling its TCP receive buffers from a softirq while only one task sleeps, causing the memcg to exceed its memory limit and triggering high-work reclaim. The second test, `test_memcg_high_work_cpu_max`, runs a CPU hog in the memcg under a cpu.max limit, ensuring that the hog gets less CPU time when high-work is busy. Both tests require swap space to be enabled so that anon memory can be reclaimed.
